description: Stack-driven geometry morph: an accumulator whose stack count CONTINUOUSLY reshapes the skill's geometry, not just its damage. Crackling Lance's Intensity (max 3 stacks) grants +35% damage/stack AND +0.3m beam width/stack AND 33% LESS branching angle/stack — the beam transforms from a wide frontal fan (0 stacks) into a focused narrow lance (3 stacks). The AoE-shrinks-as-damage-grows trade IS the skill's identity. Engine can carry the damage ramp (charge_stack_sub_shape=accumulator) OR the beam (beam_channel), but no mechanism binds 'accumulator stack count -> live geometry parameters (width, branching angle).' This is a NEW mechanism (geometry-parameterized-by-stack), hence qualitative + evidence-gated, NOT a free range extension. Filed for steward queue, NOT ratified — batch-02 grades crackling-lance APPROX as-if-un-minted. Graduate only if a 2nd/3rd kit forces the same stack-reshapes-geometry pattern (R-M5-style accrual threshold).
ladder_step_audit: tried: map (beam_channel + lightning + sunder = base skill OK) -> approximate+note (Intensity damage-ramp via accumulator, but geometry-morph unmappable; grade APPROX, deviation_notes mandatory) -> quantitative mint? NO (not a range extension of an existing param — the binding of stack->geometry does not exist) -> qualitative mint-candidate (new stack-reshapes-geometry mechanism, evidence-gated). Mapper-authored; steward ratifies before any ingest.
